art_style_description:
STYLE:
Apply this style to character and setting - High Contrast. Heavy black outlines around the entire subject. Smooth, clean color fills. Clean gradients that emphasize volume of exaggerated anatomy.

SHADING:
Use heavy shading and large highlight shapes reminiscent of retro side-scrolling beat-em-up boss artwork

COLOR:
Image composed of saturated natural colors.

TECHINICAL DETAILS:
Aspect Ratio: 1:1
